subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram Channel: Support Thread Binding for Subagent Sessions

question: Should explicit Telegram `sessions_spawn(thread:true, mode:"session")` create a new user-visible forum topic, bind only the current conversation, or expose a maintainer-approved opt-in split?
rationale: Current main implements current-conversation binding and has child-topic primitives, while the open implementation PR adds user-visible child topics and a separate open issue argues those threads should not appear by default.

options.title: Default current, opt-in child topics
options.body: Keep Telegram's current-conversation default and define an explicit capability or config seam before landing child-topic spawns.

options.title: Land child-topic behavior
options.body: Accept user-visible forum topics for explicit subagent thread spawns after resolving PR findings, conflicts, and final-head Telegram proof.

options.title: Reject child-topic behavior
options.body: Keep Telegram thread-bound subagent sessions scoped to current conversations and close child-topic implementation attempts.

recommendation.title: Default current, opt-in child topics
recommendation.body: Keep Telegram's current-conversation default and define an explicit capability or config seam before landing child-topic spawns.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the core session-binding refactor and is the strongest owner signal for deciding the permanent Telegram/thread-binding API shape.
